calculation.description: For each tradable instrument, fade its seven-session return relative to the same-day cross-sectional median, scaling by trailing 20-session daily-return volatility. The signal uses only completed historical observations and is evaluated cross-sectionally.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC and ICIR pass the benchmark gates. Daily IC was positive in 2020-22 (0.03636; ICIR 0.10703), 2023-24 (0.01980; ICIR 0.06169, below the gate), and 2025-26 (0.03289; ICIR 0.10512). Longer-horizon predictive power decays materially, so this is a short-horizon factor. Small cross-asset universe uncertainty is addressed by broad date coverage and conservative regime interpretation.
